title: Pan-Seared Portuguese Fish with Skillet Fries
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Portuguese-inspired dish with pan-seared fish and crispy skillet fries.

ingredients.name: Skillet Potatoes
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into fry shapes

instructions: 1. Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Season the fish fillets with salt and black pepper.
3. Add the olive oil to the preheated skillet and sear the fish for 2-3 minutes per side.
4. Remove the fish from the skillet and set aside.
5. Add the sliced potatoes to the skillet and fry until crispy and golden brown.
6. Remove the potatoes from the skillet and set aside with the fish.
7. Add the Port wine to the skillet and reduce over medium heat until almost completely evaporated.
8. Return the fish and potatoes to the skillet and simmer for an additional 2-3 minutes.
9. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
